name: The Party
source:
After attending a party gone wrong, Arika must testify to Detective Castello about what happened during the incident. However... just how reliable of a narrator is she?

[From [url=https://rinsdoll.itch.io/the-party]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
参加完一场闹出变故的派对后，亚里卡必须向卡斯特略警探作证，陈述事发经过。然而……身为叙述者的她，证词究竟有几分可信呢？

[摘自[url=https://rinsdoll.itch.io/the-party]itch.io[/url]]
